meta.unparsed: conditional on the observed unparsed mask: every simulated dataset has the observed unparsed cells unparsed (scored wrong) and the other cells parsed. The choice likelihood conditions on the parsed status, so the fit is unchanged; rho_m (the per-model unparsed share) enters loglik_total only
meta.null_sampling: complete 4-rotation datasets from the fitted parameters (plug-in); per score, each observed kept column redrawn (whole question) until non-constant, at most 5000 redraw rounds (else the draw fails for that score; counted)
